class.name: WorldSphereDecorator
class.brief_description: Adds or removes sphere-shaped solid terrain.
class.description: A signed sphere operation centered relative to the [RegionContainer] holding this resource. [constant ADD_SOLID] unions solid into the field, and [constant REMOVE_SOLID] carves it away. The operation respects the enclosing container chain. This is smooth volumetric terrain generation, not cube-face rendering. Boundary falloff and random generation are not implemented.

members.member: Sphere center relative to the attaching container origin. Reusing this resource in two containers places the same local shape relative to each.

Material assigned where this additive sphere supplies the field. Values 1 through 5 have earth, green, stone, sand, and deep-slate preview palettes; other IDs use the fallback palette. This is a prototype palette, not a material database.
Whether the sphere adds or removes solid.
Finite positive sphere radius in metres.

constants.constant: Add the sphere to solid terrain using a signed-field union.
Remove the sphere volume from solid terrain using signed-field subtraction.
